title: ClearPath Rate on Endpoint Installations Drawn from TimeBank Blocks
content:
**Installation ClearPath rate schedule.** On TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours, the block hours of an installation visit for a Staged Endpoint Order or Standard Endpoint Order of a client whose ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement is active at ClearPath Premier or ClearPath Enterprise are multiplied by 0.8; those of such a visit for a client whose ClearPath agreement is active at ClearPath Professional or ClearPath Standard, by 0.9; those of any other installation visit, by 1. The order type is that of the Hardware Procurement order the installation is priced on.

| Order type | Client's active ClearPath tier | Multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| Staged or Standard Endpoint Order | ClearPath Premier or Enterprise | 0.8 |
| Staged or Standard Endpoint Order | ClearPath Professional or Standard | 0.9 |
| Staged or Standard Endpoint Order | ClearPath Essentials or Monitor, or none active | 1 |
| any other order type | any | 1 |

Hypothetical case: an endpoint installation converting to 5.00 hours before this multiplier draws 4.00 hours for a ClearPath Enterprise client and 4.50 hours for a ClearPath Standard client.
